payload.summary: frank-projects has 14 direct roots but 11 belong to overlapping vehicle/camper search families, so capability-level dedup is mandatory. Rich samples provide persistent acquisition/scoring/state/scheduling/reporting fixtures and a separate web-artifact class; a research-agent sample is only a skeleton, preventing folder-name credit. One historical setup document contains credential-like plaintext despite claiming vault storage; values were not copied and archive ingestion needs a pre-write secret-redaction boundary.
